title: Royal Bank of Canada continues strong support of Britain's sporting future with SportsAid
description: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) welcomed a group of Britain's most exciting young sports stars to its Riverbank House offices in London last month as they were inducted into the bank's class of 2017 with SportsAid. RBC, one of the largest banks in the world and a partner of SportsAid since 2014, provides 50 up-and-coming athletes with financial assistance and mentoring each year.

asr.full_text: This is a special day of the year for us. It's something we've done several times now. We're here at the launch reception for our partnership with Royal Bank of Canada, an intake of the class of 2017, 50 athletes and even gender split. 31 disciplines, six Paralympic disciplines within that and all really interesting and inspiring stories so it is brilliant to bring the staff base and the athletes together and we look forward to an exciting year. I joined RBC in late 2014. Came along to the Sports Bowl that year and was really blown away by the SportsAid team and the work that they do so I proposed to the Capital Markets Management team that we join forces with The Wealth Management team and support sports aid and sponsoring 50 athletes each year. Having the team at RBC and sports aid to help me in this fourth year, for 2017, is incredible. The support has been tremendous over the years, and it can only get better from here. It's really nice to be recognized and supported especially by sportsaid, a really massive organization helps the young talent young athletes come up, and yeah, it's really great We're really really grateful to have the award from the Royal Bank of Canada through sportsaid. It's made a big difference to Will and allowed him to achieve better results than he would have done previously. I think the type of partner Sports Aid always tries to find is one that has a little bit of passion I suppose. They're curious they're good listeners and we're excited about the Royal Bank Of Canada partnership because they've got all of those things in spades so they don't just think they're financiers, or they're bankers, they're people and some of the people skills rubber upon us too. I think it's a really good team partnership and it's exciting. There's a lot of passion in the room tonight. It is a great aspiration for any young person to have, to compete in a top-level sport. We very much identify with that and I think it under pins some of our values as well. And so we are proud to be associated with SportsAid. All of our employees who interact with the SportsAid team, And athletes find it incredibly rewarding, Because we are supporting the future Of British athletic talent. So it's phenomenal for us.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it covers Royal Bank of Canada's SportsAid partnership and a launch reception for the 2017 athlete intake. The described support is ordinary sponsorship and mentoring, including financial assistance for 50 up-and-coming athletes, rather than a viewer-facing request for payment, credentials, investment, or participation. The visuals are described as consistent with a corporate-sports partnership event, with athletes or attendees and RBC/SportsAid branding.
